records.sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.currency = 'EUR') AS eur_customer_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.currency = 'CZK') AS czk_customer_count,
  ROUND(
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.currency = 'EUR')::NUMERIC
    / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.currency = 'CZK'), 0),
    4
  ) AS eur_to_czk_ratio
FROM customers c
WHERE c.currency IN ('EUR', 'CZK');
records.question: What is the ratio of customers who pay in EUR against customers who pay in CZK?
records.evidence: ratio of customers who pay in EUR against customers who pay in CZK = count(Currency = 'EUR') / count(Currency = 'CZK').
records.gold_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM customers

records.sql:
SELECT
    ym.customer_id,
    SUM(ym.consumption) AS total_consumption
FROM yearmonth AS ym
JOIN customers AS c
    ON c.customer_id = ym.customer_id
WHERE c.segment = 'LAM'
  AND ym.date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212'
GROUP BY ym.customer_id
ORDER BY total_consumption ASC
LIMIT 1;
records.question: In 2012, who had the least consumption in LAM?
records.evidence: Year 2012 can be presented as Between 201201 And 201212; The first 4 strings of the Date values in the yearmonth table can represent year.
records.gold_sql: SELECT T1.customer_id FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.customer_id = T2.customer_id WHERE T1.segment = 'LAM' AND SUBSTRING(T2.date FROM 1 FOR 4) = '2012' GROUP BY T1.customer_id ORDER BY SUM(T2.consumption) ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1

records.sql:

FROM yearmonth AS ym
JOIN customers AS c

WHERE c.segment = 'SME'

records.sql:
WITH czk_2013 AS (
  SELECT ym.customer_id,
         SUM(ym.consumption) AS annual_consumption
  FROM yearmonth ym
  JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = ym.customer_id
  WHERE c.currency = 'CZK'
    AND ym.date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
  GROUP BY ym.customer_id
),
customer_segment AS (
  SELECT ct.customer_id,
         ct.annual_consumption,
         c.segment
  FROM czk_2013 ct
  JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = ct.customer_id
  WHERE c.segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
),
segment_min AS (
  SELECT segment,
         MIN(annual_consumption) AS min_consumption
  FROM customer_segment
  GROUP BY segment
),
lowest_customers AS (
  SELECT cs.segment,
         cs.annual_consumption
  FROM customer_segment cs
  JOIN segment_min sm
    ON sm.segment = cs.segment
   AND sm.min_consumption = cs.annual_consumption
),
segment_avg AS (
  SELECT segment,
         SUM(annual_consumption) / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg_consumption
  FROM lowest_customers
  GROUP BY segment
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg_consumption END) AS sme_avg,
         MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg_consumption END) AS lam_avg,
         MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg_consumption END) AS kam_avg
  FROM segment_avg
)
SELECT sme_avg - lam_avg AS sme_minus_lam,
       lam_avg - kam_avg AS lam_minus_kam,
       kam_avg - sme_avg AS kam_minus_sme
FROM pivoted;
records.question: What is the difference in the annual average consumption of the customers with the least amount of consumption paid in CZK for 2013 between SME and LAM, LAM and KAM, and KAM and SME?
records.evidence: annual average consumption of customer with the lowest consumption in each segment = total consumption per year / the number of customer with lowest consumption in each segment; Difference in annual average = SME's annual average - LAM's annual average; Difference in annual average = LAM's annual average - KAM's annual average; Year 2013 can be presented as Between 201301 And 201312; The first 4 strings of the Date values in the yearmonth table can represent year.
records.gold_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.segment = 'SME' THEN T2.consumption ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.customer_id), 0) - CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.segment = 'LAM' THEN T2.consumption ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.customer_id), 0), CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.segment = 'LAM' THEN T2.consumption ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.customer_id), 0) - CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.segment = 'KAM' THEN T2.consumption ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.customer_id), 0), CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.segment = 'KAM' THEN T2.consumption ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.customer_id), 0) - CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.segment = 'SME' THEN T2.consumption ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.customer_id), 0) FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.customer_id = T2.customer_id WHERE T1.currency = 'CZK' AND T2.consumption = (SELECT MIN(consumption) FROM yearmonth) AND CAST(T2.date AS TEXT) BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'

records.sql:
WITH eur_customers AS (
  SELECT customer_id, segment
  FROM customers
  WHERE currency = 'EUR'
    AND segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
),
consumption_by_year AS (
  SELECT
    c.segment,
    LEFT(ym.date, 4) AS yr,
    SUM(ym.consumption) AS total_consumption
  FROM yearmonth ym
  INNER JOIN eur_customers c ON c.customer_id = ym.customer_id
  WHERE LEFT(ym.date, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
  GROUP BY c.segment, LEFT(ym.date, 4)
),
segment_totals AS (
  SELECT
    segment,
    MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE yr = '2012') AS consumption_2012,
    MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE yr = '2013') AS consumption_2013
  FROM consumption_by_year
  GROUP BY segment
),
segment_pct AS (
  SELECT
    segment,
    consumption_2012,
    consumption_2013,
    consumption_2013 - consumption_2012 AS increase_or_decrease,
    ROUND((consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) / NULLIF(consumption_2013, 0) * 100, 4) AS pct_increase
  FROM segment_totals
)
SELECT
  'Biggest percentage increase' AS result_type,
  segment,
  consumption_2012,
  consumption_2013,
  increase_or_decrease,
  pct_increase
FROM segment_pct
WHERE pct_increase = (SELECT MAX(pct_increase) FROM segment_pct)
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Lowest percentage increase' AS result_type,
  segment,
  consumption_2012,
  consumption_2013,
  increase_or_decrease,
  pct_increase
FROM segment_pct
WHERE pct_increase = (SELECT MIN(pct_increase) FROM segment_pct)
ORDER BY pct_increase DESC;
records.question: Which of the three segments—SME, LAM and KAM—has the biggest and lowest percentage increases in consumption paid in EUR between 2012 and 2013?
records.evidence: Increase or Decrease = consumption for 2013 - consumption for 2012; Percentage of Increase = (Increase or Decrease / consumption for 2013) * 100%; The first 4 strings of the Date values in the yearmonth table can represent year
records.gold_sql: SELECT CAST((SUM(CASE WHEN T1.segment = 'SME' AND T2.date LIKE '2013%' THEN T2.consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T1.segment = 'SME' AND T2.date LIKE '2012%' THEN T2.consumption ELSE 0 END)) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.segment = 'SME' AND T2.date LIKE '2012%' THEN T2.consumption ELSE 0 END), 0), CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.segment = 'LAM' AND T2.date LIKE '2013%' THEN T2.consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T1.segment = 'LAM' AND T2.date LIKE '2012%' THEN T2.consumption ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.segment = 'LAM' AND T2.date LIKE '2012%' THEN T2.consumption ELSE 0 END), 0), CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.segment = 'KAM' AND T2.date LIKE '2013%' THEN T2.consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T1.segment = 'KAM' AND T2.date LIKE '2012%' THEN T2.consumption ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.segment = 'KAM' AND T2.date LIKE '2012%' THEN T2.consumption ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.customer_id = T2.customer_id

records.sql:
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sme_czk_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sme_eur_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diff_czk_minus_eur,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
       > SUM(CASE WHEN currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) THEN 'Yes'
    ELSE 'No'
  END AS more_smes_pay_czk
FROM customers
WHERE segment = 'SME';
records.question: Is it true that more SMEs pay in Czech koruna than in euros? If so, how many more?
records.evidence: Amount of more SMEs = Total of SMEs pay using Currency CZK - Total of SMEs pay using Currency EUR
records.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM customers WHERE segment = 'SME'

records.sql:
SELECT
    ROUND(
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE customer_total_amount > 46.73) * 100.0
      / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
      4
    ) AS pct_lam_customers_over_threshold
FROM (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        SUM(t.amount) AS customer_total_amount
    FROM customers c
    JOIN transactions_1k t
      ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE c.segment = 'LAM'
    GROUP BY c.customer_id
) AS customer_totals
records.question: How many percent of LAM customer consumed more than 46.73?
records.evidence: Percentage of LAM customer consumed more than 46.73 = (Total no. of LAM customers who consumed more than 46.73 / Total no. of LAM customers) * 100.
records.gold_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.consumption > 46.73 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.customer_id), 0) FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.customer_id = T2.customer_id WHERE T1.segment = 'LAM'

records.sql:
WITH target_customer AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT t.customer_id
  FROM transactions_1k AS t
  WHERE t.date = DATE '2012-08-25'
    AND t.price = 634.8
),
yearly AS (
  SELECT
    y.customer_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN y.date LIKE '2012%' THEN y.consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
    SUM(CASE WHEN y.date LIKE '2013%' THEN y.consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
  FROM yearmonth AS y
  JOIN target_customer AS tc
    ON tc.customer_id = y.customer_id
  GROUP BY y.customer_id
)
SELECT
  consumption_2012,
  consumption_2013,
  (consumption_2012 - consumption_2013) / NULLIF(consumption_2012, 0) AS consumption_decrease_rate
FROM yearly;
records.question: For the customer who paid 634.8 in 2012/8/25, what was the consumption decrease rate from Year 2012 to 2013?
records.evidence: '2012/8/24' can be represented by '2012-08-24'; Consumption decrease rate = (consumption_2012 - consumption_2013) / consumption_2012; paid 634.8 refers to price = '634.8'
records.gold_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(date FROM 1 FOR 4) = '2012' THEN consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(date FROM 1 FOR 4) = '2013' THEN consumption ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(date FROM 1 FOR 4) = '2012' THEN consumption ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM yearmonth WHERE customer_id = (SELECT T1.customer_id FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.gas_station_id = T2.gas_station_id WHERE T1.date = '2012-08-25' AND T1.price = 1513.12)

records.sql:
SELECT
  segment,
  COUNT(*) AS segment_count,
  SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS total_count,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS pct_of_total
FROM gasstations
WHERE country = 'SVK'
GROUP BY segment
ORDER BY segment_count DESC;
records.question: What is the percentage of "premium" against the overall segment in Country = "SVK"?
records.gold_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN country = 'SVK' AND segment = 'Premium' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN country = 'SVK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM gasstations

records.sql:
SELECT 38508 AS customer_id,
       COALESCE((SELECT SUM(t.amount)
                 FROM transactions_1k t
                 WHERE t.customer_id = 38508), 0) AS total_spent_at_gas_stations,
       COALESCE((SELECT y.consumption
                 FROM yearmonth y
                 WHERE y.customer_id = 38508
                   AND y.date = '201201'), 0) AS spent_january_2012;
records.question: What is the amount spent by customer "38508" at the gas stations? How much had the customer spent in January 2012?
records.evidence: January 2012 refers to the Date value = '201201'
records.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(T1.price), SUM(CASE WHEN T3.date = '201201' THEN T1.price ELSE 0 END) FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.gas_station_id = T2.gas_station_id INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T3 ON T1.customer_id = T3.customer_id WHERE T1.customer_id = '38508'

records.sql:
WITH customer_spending AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    SUM(price) AS total_spending,
    SUM(price) / NULLIF(SUM(amount), 0) AS avg_price_per_item
  FROM transactions_1k
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
top_customer AS (
  SELECT customer_id, total_spending, avg_price_per_item
  FROM customer_spending
  ORDER BY total_spending DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  t.customer_id,
  t.total_spending,
  t.avg_price_per_item,
  c.currency
FROM top_customer t
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id
records.question: Who is the top spending customer and how much is the average price per single item purchased by this customer? What currency was being used?
records.evidence: average price per single item = Total(price) / Total(amount)
records.gold_sql: SELECT T2.customer_id, SUM(T2.price / NULLIF(T2.amount, 0)), T1.currency FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS T2 ON T1.customer_id = T2.customer_id WHERE T2.customer_id = (SELECT customer_id FROM yearmonth ORDER BY consumption DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) GROUP BY T2.customer_id, T1.currency

records.sql:
SELECT
    ym.customer_id,
    ym.consumption
FROM yearmonth AS ym
WHERE ym.date = '201208'
  AND ym.customer_id IN (
    SELECT t.customer_id
    FROM transactions_1k AS t
    WHERE t.product_id = 5
      AND t.amount > 0
      AND (t.price / t.amount) > 29.00
  )
ORDER BY ym.consumption DESC;
records.question: For all the people who paid more than 29.00 per unit of product id No.5. Give their consumption status in the August of 2012.
records.evidence: August of 2012 refers to the Date value = '201208' ; Price per unit of product = Price / Amount;
records.gold_sql: SELECT T2.consumption FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.customer_id = T2.customer_id WHERE T1.price / NULLIF(T1.amount, 0) > 29.00 AND T1.product_id = 5 AND T2.date = '201208'
